scope: Every guarded source site was passed to the literal-table unbounded unary/list induction engine, with arbitrary natural primary registers, arbitrary natural additional gap, arbitrary first spare, arbitrary finite remaining spare list, and complete blank exterior. preconditions: All assertions enabled. The existing engine proof-search bound is4000 symbolic rules percase; it is not a bound on represented unary lengths or execution time.
